dedupe_keys.name: earthquake responses of a seismically isolated cylindrical fluid filled vessel

description: Earthquake responses of a seismically isolated, cylindrical, fluid-filled vessel is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Andrew Whittaker, University at Buffalo (buffalo.edu). Earthquake-simulator experiments were conducted on a fluid-filled, cylindrical vessel, base isolated using four single concave friction pendulum bearings (SFP isolators), utilizing a six-degrees-of-freedom earthquake simulator at the University at Buffalo. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: base isolation, fluid structure interaction, friction pendulum bearings, storage tanks. Published 2022-12-27. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
